text: Speaker 5 It took a while to get used to working nights, but I quite like it now, because for every ten days I work, I get a week off. It is quite boring, though, packing boxes all night, and I sometimes get back ache from bending over and lifting a lot. People often say it must be great to work where they make chocolate. I did used to eat some when I first started here, but you quickly get fed up with it. And of course it is fattening. I hardly ever eat it now.
